verdict.rationale: Pulumi's first-party docs say `pulumi import` adopts an existing cloud resource into stack state and generates the code to manage it (pulumi-docs-25, pulumi-docs-6, pulumi-docs-17). `pulumi preview --import-file` produces an import file covering the resources a program would otherwise create, which supports bulk import (pulumi-docs-21), and migration from Terraform and CloudFormation is also documented (pulumi-docs-10). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the import and code generation work in practice, and detail on how generated code is integrated beyond manually copying it into the program.
